lines.text: How's the shoulder since last time?
Since last time it's loosening a little, I'm only guessing though.
Let me have a look. Out to the side you're at about ninety degrees, so maybe ten better than last month.
The massage on my upper back helped my sleep, I'll tell you that for nothing.
Your sugar levels can slow this down, so keep the stretches going even when it feels like nothing's changing.
Lovely, see you in three weeks, take it easy.
Morning! Sorry for the wait, come through.
No bother. My GP said I've got a trapped nerve in my neck, but I'm honestly not convinced.
